hunks.baseline: The ball had rolled far wide of the hole and only stopped after striking Team Leader 1’s shoe. As he bent down to pick it up, Im Chunsoo waved him off.
hunks.sol: The ball had rolled well wide of the hole and only stopped when it struck Team Leader 1’s shoe. As he bent to pick it up, Im Chunsoo waved him off.

hunks.baseline: “Forget it. Come over here and have some tea.”
hunks.sol: “Leave it. Come have some tea.”

hunks.baseline: A brief silence passed between them. After savoring his tea, Im Chunsoo suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: They sat in silence for a moment. Im Chunsoo took a sip of tea, then spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Ah, yes. I suppose it must be good tea.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, yes. It must be good tea.”

hunks.baseline: “This is Longjing tea. I received it as a gift, but to be honest, I don’t really know what it is. It’s just filthy expensive.”
hunks.sol: “It’s called Longjing tea. Someone gave it to me, but honestly, I don’t know much about it. It’s just damn expensive.”

hunks.baseline: “Not at all. I only pretend to savor it because I want to look sophisticated. At home, I drink instant coffee.”
hunks.sol: “Not at all. I only pretend to savor it because it makes me look sophisticated. At home, I drink instant coffee.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader 1 let out a quiet laugh. Im Chunsoo’s love of tea was famous among the Guild executives. They had even begun competing to see who could give the Guild Master the better tea.
hunks.sol: Team Leader 1 let out a quiet laugh. Im Chunsoo’s love of tea was famous among the Guild executives. They had even begun competing to see who could give the Guild Master the finest tea.

hunks.baseline: “A few people are going to be surprised.”
hunks.sol: “A few people will be surprised to hear that.”

hunks.baseline: “Fire that bastard. He’s lost his mind thinking about gathering weeds instead of doing his job.”
hunks.sol: “Fire that bastard. He’s too busy thinking about gathering weeds to do his job.”

hunks.baseline: “You’re serious?”
hunks.sol: “Are you serious?”

hunks.baseline: Light laughter passed between them. Im Chunsoo gulped down the remaining tea as if it were cold water, then smacked his lips.
hunks.sol: A light laugh passed between them. Im Chunsoo gulped down the rest of his tea as if it were cold water, then smacked his lips.

hunks.baseline: “You have some new information. I went out of my way to tell you a secret because you were having trouble speaking up…”
hunks.sol: “You brought news. I even went out of my way to tell you a secret because you were having trouble spitting it out…”

hunks.baseline: “Look in a mirror before you come in next time. With a long face like that, anyone could tell.”
hunks.sol: “Look in a mirror before you come in next time. Anyone could tell with a face that grim.”

hunks.baseline: “The investigation into the Peace Guild that you ordered previously… has failed.”
hunks.sol: “The investigation into the Peace Guild that you ordered… has failed.”

hunks.baseline: “Explain in more detail.”
hunks.sol: “Explain.”

hunks.baseline: “They approached carefully, but they say it would be better not to provoke the Peace Guild Master or Team Leader.”
hunks.sol: “They approached cautiously, but they say it would be best not to provoke the Peace Guild Master or Team Leader.”

hunks.baseline: “I expected as much. I should have made the request personally. In the end, I didn’t step in because of my useless pride, so some of the blame is mine.”
hunks.sol: “I expected as much. I should have made the request personally. In the end, I stayed out of it because of my useless pride, so some of the blame is mine.”

hunks.baseline: “No, it was because I was inadequate.”
hunks.sol: “No, sir. It was my own inadequacy.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s true, too. Even if those locked-down bastards were out of reach, this C-rank Hunter named Jin Taekyung should have been a success.”
hunks.sol: “That’s true, too. Even if those locked-down bastards were out of reach, you should have succeeded with that C-rank Hunter, Jin Taekyung.”

hunks.baseline: “Why exactly did you fail? I gave you a Familiar mage hired from outside and even assigned the Guild’s Security Team to him.”
hunks.sol: “Why exactly did you fail? I gave you a Familiar mage hired from outside and even assigned the Guild’s Security Team to the job.”

hunks.baseline: “Hm? That bastard Hong Woojin?”
hunks.sol: “Hm? With that bastard Hong Woojin?”

hunks.baseline: “Hong Woojin disappeared after leaving a single text message. The ones we lost contact with were the Security Team.”
hunks.sol: “Hong Woojin left a single text message and disappeared. It’s the Security Team we lost contact with.”

hunks.baseline: “Why the Security Team? Don’t they report the situation regularly?”
hunks.sol: “Why the Security Team? Don’t they report in regularly?”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. Reports come in every two hours, but… the last one was four hours ago.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. They report every two hours, but… the last report came four hours ago.”

hunks.baseline: “Are you saying the entire Security Team walked out on us?”
hunks.sol: “Are you saying the entire Security Team deserted?”

hunks.baseline: “No. Judging by the circumstances, it’s highly likely Jin Taekyung got to them.”
hunks.sol: “No. Judging by the circumstances, Jin Taekyung most likely got to them.”

hunks.baseline: As Im Chunsoo stared at him in disbelief, Team Leader 1 handed him the pages he had printed out.
hunks.sol: As Im Chunsoo stared at him in disbelief, Team Leader 1 handed him a printout.

hunks.baseline: The fact that only certain sections had been highlighted in red showed that this was an emergency report, not a regular one.
hunks.sol: Only certain sections were printed in red, marking it as an emergency report rather than a routine one.

hunks.baseline: Im Chunsoo’s eyes raced across the words.
hunks.sol: Im Chunsoo’s eyes raced across the page.

hunks.baseline: The target had spoken on the phone with someone whose identity was unknown, and both the contents of the conversation and the target’s actions were suspicious. After reading the report from beginning to end, Im Chunsoo let out a sigh.
hunks.sol: The target had spoken on the phone with an unidentified person, and both the contents of the conversation and his subsequent actions were suspicious. After reading the entire report, Im Chunsoo sighed.

hunks.baseline: “The Security Team Leader contacted me directly. He said they needed to pursue the target immediately, so he would take action first and report afterward.”
hunks.sol: “The Security Team Leader contacted me directly. He said they needed to pursue the target immediately, so he would act first and report afterward.”

hunks.baseline: Im Chunsoo fell deep into thought as he tapped the table.
hunks.sol: Deep in thought, Im Chunsoo tapped the table.

hunks.baseline: When he raised his head, the high-quality wooden table had frozen solid.
hunks.sol: By the time he raised his head, the expensive wooden table had frozen solid.

hunks.baseline: “Who did Jin Taekyung call? You found out at least the person’s full name, or you wouldn’t have shown me this.”
hunks.sol: “Who did Jin Taekyung call? You must have at least gotten the man’s full name, or you wouldn’t be showing me this.”

hunks.baseline: “Seong Jinho. A thirty-year-old exam candidate living in Bucheon.”
hunks.sol: “Seong Jinho. A thirty-year-old civil service exam candidate living in Bucheon.”

hunks.baseline: “……Team Leader 1. Did I hear you wrong? An exam candidate, not a Hunter?”
hunks.sol: “…Team Leader 1. Did I hear that wrong? An exam candidate, not a Hunter?”

hunks.baseline: “I checked again myself, but there’s no mistake. He’s the manager of the goshiwon where Jin Taekyung lives. They’re supposedly like sworn brothers.”
hunks.sol: “I checked twice myself, but there’s no mistake. He’s the manager of the goshiwon where Jin Taekyung lives. They’re supposedly as close as sworn brothers.”

hunks.baseline: “Hah. Today keeps surprising me.”
hunks.sol: “Hah. I’ve been surprised more than once today.”

hunks.baseline: Im Chunsoo had expected him to be at least an A-rank Hunter. But what was this? A civilian exam candidate?
hunks.sol: Im Chunsoo had expected the man to be at least an A-rank Hunter. But he was a civilian studying for an exam?

hunks.baseline: “Ugh, we really got played. How does a Guild with only five people have so much to hide?”
hunks.sol: “Ugh, we got played good. Why does a Guild with only five people have so much to hide?”

hunks.baseline: “What do you mean, what should we do? It’s almost dinnertime. We should go have a meal.”
hunks.sol: “What do you mean? It’s almost dinnertime, so we should go get something to eat.”

hunks.baseline: “……What?”
hunks.sol: “…Sir?”

hunks.baseline: “Stop talking and follow me.”
hunks.sol: “Stop asking questions and follow me.”

hunks.baseline: He was thinking of having dinner in Ilsan that evening.
hunks.sol: He planned to have dinner in Ilsan that evening.

hunks.baseline: To begin with, Choi Byungil was the only one who could exchange blows with me. Even he didn’t last long before dropping to his knees.
hunks.sol: Choi Byungil was the only one among them capable of trading blows with me, and even he didn’t last long before dropping to his knees.

hunks.baseline: *Obviously.*
hunks.sol: *Well, obviously.*

hunks.baseline: But it seemed to have been a tremendous shock to someone.
hunks.sol: But it seemed to have come as quite a shock to him.

hunks.baseline: With both ankles broken, Choi Byungil continued talking to me with a face as white as a sheet.
hunks.sol: With both ankles broken, Choi Byungil kept talking to me, his face white as a sheet.

hunks.baseline: “I’m with the Peace Guild. And Ares Guild wouldn’t be interested in your Guild. You’re in completely different weight classes.”
hunks.sol: “I’m with the Peace Guild. And Ares Guild probably doesn’t care about your Guild. You’re in completely different weight classes.”

hunks.baseline: In the end, there was nothing for it but to use the mouth-sealing technique. I tore his clothes into strips and gagged him, then treated all the remaining wounded, including him.
hunks.sol: In the end, I had no choice but to use the Mouth-Sealing Technique. I tore strips from his clothes and gagged him, then treated all the wounded, including him.

hunks.baseline: Of course, I didn’t use the potions I had bought from the Store.
hunks.sol: Of course, I didn’t use any of the potions I had bought from the Store.

hunks.baseline: “Wow, Sangdong Guild gives you guys some serious support.”
hunks.sol: “Wow, Sangdong Guild really gives you guys some serious support.”

hunks.baseline: Even after looting only what they had brought with them, the quality and quantity of their Equipment and consumables were nothing to sneeze at. I used some of them for treatment, and the rest…
hunks.sol: Just looting what they had brought yielded an impressive quantity of high-quality Equipment and consumables. I used some to treat them, and as for the rest…

hunks.baseline: “I’m confiscating this for now. Anyone have a problem with that?”
hunks.sol: “I’m confiscating all this for now. Anyone have a problem with that?”

hunks.baseline: They must have been so intimidated by my overwhelming strength that, even after their injuries had been healed, they didn’t dare attack me again. They were fairly smart men.
hunks.sol: They must have been thoroughly cowed by my overwhelming strength. Even after their injuries were treated, none of them dared to attack me again. They were pretty smart.

hunks.baseline: The Familiar mage, Kim Junsu, flinched. Then he declared with a resolute expression,
hunks.sol: Kim Junsu, the Familiar mage, flinched before declaring with a resolute expression,

hunks.baseline: “I’m with the Security Team. I cannot carelessly disclose the Guild’s confidential information to an outsider.”
hunks.sol: “I’m a member of the Security Team. I cannot divulge confidential Guild information to an outsider.”

hunks.baseline: A small sound like tape being ripped came from somewhere, and his wig came clean off. The gleaming bald crown hidden beneath it was exposed.
hunks.sol: There was a faint sound like tape being ripped away, and his wig came clean off. The gleaming bald crown hidden beneath it was exposed.

hunks.baseline: “What is this?!”
hunks.sol: “What the—!”

hunks.baseline: “From now on, if you lie or keep claiming ignorance in response to my questions, I’ll pluck your hair out by the handful.”
hunks.sol: “From now on, every time you lie or pretend not to know the answer to one of my questions, I’ll pluck out a handful of hair.”

hunks.baseline: After that, everything proceeded smoothly. All kinds of information poured from the mouth of a balding man desperate to protect his hair by any means necessary.
hunks.sol: Everything went smoothly after that. All kinds of information poured from the mouth of a balding man desperate to protect his hair at any cost.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. He’s a B-rank mage hired from outside by Team Leader 1. Like me, his specialty is Familiar magic.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. He’s a B-rank mage Team Leader 1 hired from outside. Like me, he specializes in Familiar magic.”

hunks.baseline: What a waste. I should have caught that bastard and beaten the information out of him, too.
hunks.sol: What a shame. I should have caught that bastard and beaten the information out of him, too.

hunks.baseline: Smacking my lips, I continued extracting information. Whenever Kim Junsu seemed to hesitate, I encouraged him by fiddling with his remaining hair.
hunks.sol: Smacking my lips, I continued extracting information. Whenever Kim Junsu hesitated, I encouraged him by playing with what little hair he had left.

hunks.baseline: “That’s everything. I really mean it, that’s all. Even though I’m in the Security Team, I truly don’t know anything else. So please, just leave my hair alone…”
hunks.sol: “That’s everything. I swear, that’s all. I may be on the Security Team, but I really don’t know anything else. So please, just spare my hair…”

hunks.baseline: His tone was full of both resentment and sincerity. The final words in particular struck a chord with me.
hunks.sol: His voice rang with both resentment and sincerity. That last plea in particular struck a chord with me.

hunks.baseline: *This should be more or less everything.*
hunks.sol: *That should about wrap things up.*

hunks.baseline: The mastermind behind it was the Sangdong Guild—or, more precisely, Im Chunsoo.
hunks.sol: The mastermind was the Sangdong Guild—or, more precisely, Im Chunsoo.

hunks.baseline: After seeing that his spendthrift son had been shaken down for a hundred million won in income, he had started digging into our Guild.
hunks.sol: He had seen his spendthrift son get shaken down for a hundred million won and immediately started digging into our Guild.

hunks.baseline: Well, in the end, I was the one who robbed him instead.
hunks.sol: Well, in the end, I turned the tables and cleaned them out instead.

hunks.baseline: “Is that some line reserved for weaklings? Forget invoking the Guild Master and clean up the shit you made yourself.”
hunks.sol: “Is that some stock line reserved for weaklings? Forget about invoking your Guild Master and worry about cleaning up your own shit.”
“…Tch.”

hunks.baseline: At my sharp retort, Choi Byungil lowered his head in frustration. But the man wasn’t entirely wrong.
hunks.sol: At my sharp retort, Choi Byungil lowered his head in frustration. Still, he wasn’t entirely wrong.

hunks.baseline: He had sent his subordinates to watch me, only for them to get robbed and captured instead. For the Guild Master—and the Guild as a whole—this was about as fucking humiliating as it got.
hunks.sol: He had sent his subordinates to watch me, only for them to get robbed and captured instead. For the Guild Master—and the entire Guild—this was about as fucking humiliating as it got.

hunks.baseline: That was when it happened.
hunks.sol: I was still staring at my smartphone when it rang.

hunks.baseline: What was this?
hunks.sol: *What’s this?*

hunks.baseline: A strange tension rose within me for no apparent reason as I answered.
hunks.sol: For some reason, I felt strangely tense as I answered.

hunks.baseline: “Come downstairs. I’m waiting below.”
hunks.sol: —Come down. I’m waiting below.

hunks.baseline: “Jin Taekyung. That’s right, isn’t it?”
hunks.sol: —Jin Taekyung. That’s you, isn’t it?

hunks.baseline: “My name is Im Chunsoo. I heard you have a few of my people with you.”
hunks.sol: —My name is Im Chunsoo. I heard you have a few of my people with you.

hunks.baseline: “Are you listening?”
hunks.sol: —Are you listening?

hunks.baseline: The Guild Master of a mid-sized Guild had come all the way here himself to meet me. And it was Im Chunsoo, of all people—the man with the terrible temper.
hunks.sol: The Guild Master of a mid-sized Guild had come all the way here himself to meet me. And it was Im Chunsoo, of all people—the man notorious for his temper.

hunks.baseline: “Come down. We can clear up any misunderstandings over a meal.”
hunks.sol: —Come down. We can clear up any misunderstandings over a meal.

hunks.baseline: There was no misunderstanding that needed clearing up, but I had no idea what would happen if I said, *No.*
hunks.sol: There was no misunderstanding to clear up, but I had no idea what would happen if I said, *No.*

hunks.baseline: Hadn’t the man already found out my location?
hunks.sol: Hadn’t he already tracked down my location?

hunks.baseline: In the end, I had only one option.
hunks.sol: In the end, I had only one choice.

hunks.baseline: “I’ll be down shortly.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll come down now.”

hunks.baseline: Im Chunsoo’s first impression was intense. He was younger than I expected, and although his eyes seemed gentle, they burned with heat.
hunks.sol: Im Chunsoo made a powerful first impression. He was younger than I had expected, and although his eyes seemed gentle, they burned with heat.

hunks.baseline: “Hello. My name is Jin Taekyung.”
hunks.sol: “Hello. I’m Jin Taekyung.”

hunks.baseline: His voice was cold, unlike his burning gaze. At last, he seemed like someone who deserved the nickname Frozen.
hunks.sol: Unlike his burning gaze, his voice was cold. Now he finally seemed like someone worthy of the epithet Frozen.

hunks.baseline: “It’s interesting to see in person the face I’d only seen in report photos.”
hunks.sol: “It’s strange seeing in person a face I’ve only seen in report photos.”

hunks.baseline: There were actually people who could admit so bluntly and without embarrassment that they had dug into my background.
hunks.sol: So there really were people capable of admitting without a hint of embarrassment that they had investigated someone’s background.

hunks.baseline: “They’re upstairs.”
hunks.sol: “They’re up there.”

hunks.baseline: “Are there any fatalities?”
hunks.sol: “Any fatalities?”

hunks.baseline: “Of course not. I have no desire to become a criminal.”
hunks.sol: “Of course not. I’d hate to become a criminal.”

hunks.baseline: “If there’s reasonable compensation.”
hunks.sol: “If there’s appropriate compensation.”

hunks.baseline: Im Chunsoo let out a quiet laugh, and the man beside him, who looked like a Team Leader, frowned.
hunks.sol: Im Chunsoo gave a short laugh, while the man beside him, who looked like a Team Leader, frowned.

hunks.baseline: “Young man, you’re rude.”
hunks.sol: “Young man, you have no manners.”

hunks.baseline: “I am, somewhat… but hearing that from someone who even put me under surveillance feels a little strange.”
hunks.sol: “I can be like that… but it feels a little strange hearing it from the people who put me under surveillance.”

hunks.baseline: The man couldn’t continue. Im Changsoo raised a hand to stop him.
hunks.sol: The man couldn’t continue. Im Chunsoo raised a hand to stop him.

hunks.baseline: “Team Leader 1, go upstairs and release my people.”
hunks.sol: “Team Leader 1, go up and release our people.”

hunks.baseline: “……Yes, Guild Master.”
hunks.sol: “…Yes, Guild Master.”

hunks.baseline: If Kim Butler possessed a gentle charisma, this man possessed a rough one. Maybe it was because they were both mages. Somehow, the two men overlapped in my mind.
hunks.sol: If Kim Butler possessed a gentle charisma, Im Chunsoo’s was rough and forceful. Was it because they were both mages? Somehow, the two men overlapped in my mind.

hunks.baseline: Im Changsoo went ahead, and I followed behind him.
hunks.sol: Im Chunsoo set off, and I followed.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: After walking briskly for a while, Im Chunsoo suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: After striding along in silence for a while, Im Chunsoo suddenly spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Once I have a grudge against someone, I have to see it through to the end. I don’t know about you, but that’s the kind of person I am.”
hunks.sol: “Once I make an enemy, I have to see it through to the end. I don’t know about you, but that’s the kind of man I am.”

hunks.baseline: The strong devour the weak. Survival of the fittest. It seemed the blood of a Murim tough guy flowed through this man’s veins, too.
hunks.sol: The strong devoured the weak. Survival of the fittest. It seemed this man had the blood of a Murim tough guy running through his veins, too.

hunks.baseline: “That’s how I built the Sangdong Guild. I climbed higher by stepping on what I had brought down and salvaging whatever I could.”
hunks.sol: “That’s how I built the Sangdong Guild. I trampled what I brought down, salvaged what I could, and used it to climb higher.”

hunks.baseline: “……What do you mean?”
hunks.sol: “…What do you mean?”

hunks.baseline: “The past decade has been dull. We’re allies with every nearby Guild, and we haven’t had a rival for a long time. Then you people appeared.”
hunks.sol: “The past decade has been dull. We’re allied with every nearby Guild, and we haven’t had a rival for years. Then you people appeared.”

hunks.baseline: As I looked into his eyes, where curiosity and passion seemed to be boiling, I had only one thought.
hunks.sol: I looked into his eyes, where curiosity and passion seemed to boil, and had only one thought.

hunks.baseline: Whether I cared or not, Im Chunsoo continued speaking.
hunks.sol: Im Chunsoo continued, regardless.

hunks.baseline: “Your Guild Master and Team Leader are people whose information I can’t easily access myself… But more than anything, your existence has stirred me up.”
hunks.sol: “Your Guild Master and Team Leader are people even I can’t easily access information on… But more than anything, your existence has stirred something in me.”

hunks.baseline: We were climbing a hill now. Despite his considerable age, Im Chunsoo didn’t seem short of breath.
hunks.sol: We were climbing a hill now. Despite his age, Im Chunsoo didn’t seem remotely short of breath.

hunks.baseline: “You’re only half right.”
hunks.sol: “You’re half right.”

hunks.baseline: Im Chunsoo’s footsteps stopped. Slowly turning around, he released a frigid chill from his entire body.
hunks.sol: Im Chunsoo stopped. As he slowly turned, frigid air rolled from his body.

hunks.baseline: “At my age, time is money. I’m not so indulgent that I’d come all the way here just to see your face.”
hunks.sol: “At my age, time is precious. I’m not so extravagant that I’d come all this way just to see your face.”

hunks.baseline: Frozen. The seasoned A-rank mage who had fought his way through the Great Cataclysm himself.
hunks.sol: Frozen. A seasoned A-rank mage who had fought his way through the Great Cataclysm.

hunks.baseline: The moment he extended his hand toward me—
hunks.sol: The moment he extended a hand toward me—

hunks.baseline: Around a dozen ice spikes formed in the empty air above my head. The midsummer air froze, and frost settled over the scorching dirt path.
hunks.sol: A dozen or so ice spikes formed in the empty air above my head. The midsummer air froze, and frost spread over the sun-scorched dirt path.

hunks.baseline: *I’d been well and truly caught.*
hunks.sol: *I’d really stepped in it this time.*

hunks.baseline: I had thought he was an old man with some sense of propriety. I never imagined he would launch straight into something like this.
hunks.sol: I had thought the old man had some sense of propriety. I never imagined he would attack me without warning.

hunks.baseline: “Exactly. I want to see what that C-rank Hunter can do.”
hunks.sol: “Exactly. Let’s see what that C-rank Hunter can do.”

hunks.baseline: The moment he finished speaking, Im Chunsoo clenched his fist. The ice spikes, streaming with biting cold, shot toward me.
hunks.sol: The moment he finished speaking, Im Chunsoo clenched his fist. The ice spikes, radiating bitter cold, shot toward me.

hunks.baseline: But they couldn’t even touch the hem of my clothes.
hunks.sol: But they never touched so much as the hem of my clothes.

hunks.baseline: “Rise up. Fire Wall.”
hunks.sol: “Rise. Fire Wall.”

hunks.baseline: At the sound of a clear voice, the mana permeating the air began to churn. The ground, which had been frosted over by Im Chunsoo’s magic, melted as flames surged upward.
hunks.sol: At the clear command, the mana permeating the air churned. The frost covering the ground melted, and flames surged upward.

hunks.baseline: Fwoosh! Fwoosh!
hunks.sol: Fwoosh! Roar!

hunks.baseline: It was exactly what its name suggested: a wall of fire. Blue flames swallowed the ice spikes and split the space between Im Chunsoo and me.
hunks.sol: It was a wall of fire in the most literal sense. Blue flames swallowed the ice spikes and divided the space between Im Chunsoo and me.

hunks.baseline: “What is this…!”
hunks.sol: “This is…!”

hunks.baseline: But I wasn’t looking at Im Chunsoo.
hunks.sol: But I wasn’t looking at him.

hunks.baseline: Behind him, a man standing at the entrance to the hiking trail greeted me in a gentle voice.
hunks.sol: A man standing behind him at the entrance to the hiking trail greeted us in a gentle voice.

hunks.baseline: “I’m glad I’m not late. Chunsoo, you’re here too.”
hunks.sol: “I’m glad I made it in time. You too, Chunsoo.”
